items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: show their students that jazz isn’t all about Charlie Parker and beyond

ctx.x: I agree and for those that might not have enough students to have the traditional big band. That’s the way most people go but some schools, I know when I taught high school I had to write my own arrangements because I had an odd mix of people, I didn’t have a full big band so this might be good for those kind of rural schools perhaps that don’t have the numbers.

Right. Well I hope so. And there are a lot of jazz lab band directors who are not players and don’t improvise, maybe come from a classical background, but they still, you know, wave their arms in front of a big jazz lab band, you know, so for those who are not jazzers themselves but are willing to teach it, if they have the right tools, I hope we’re © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
giving them the right tools here, to show their students that jazz isn’t all about Charlie Parker and beyond or John Coltrane and beyond.
